runs.outcome: fresh address refused at the token (PolicyForbids(TRANSFER_RECEIVER_POLICY, 216172782113783973)), admitted -> the same transfer passes (eth_call returns true), removed -> refused again; line owner removed -> the desk refuses withdrawCollateral itself with PolicyForbids(TRANSFER_RECEIVER_POLICY, 0xB789aD318945B37566E2549F65526Cc269a482Fc) before Morpho is called (Morpho alone: Error("transfer reverted")); re-admitted -> passes again
runs.notes: The partner boundline-app has no IEligibility hook, so the desk's NOT_ELIGIBLE reason is not exercised here: the refusal comes from the issuer's Cobalt policy, checked by the desk's B20 preflight (isAuthorized on both legs) and by the token. The fresh address has no key and never held TSLAt; only eth_call simulations touched it.
